notes.text: The Bavli gives the identification as an alternate and says Elijah spoke only with the one who fed the attendant earlier. It does not establish the priesthood or the next Rava report at that locus.
The separate exact locus is Kiddushin 32b:2. Keep this link distinct from the Elijah narrative in Ketubot.
